Root caused this: the Tahoe menu bar window is fully transparent, so Ice's average color capture ends up dividing by zero and produces a NaN color. Hi @thomasquinlan / everyone hitting this on macOS 26 Tahoe — I've been debugging this exact symptom on a maintained fork of Ice and have a diagnosis + working fix.

**Root cause** (`Ice 0.11.13-dev.2` and earlier on macOS 26):

This bug is the **client side** of upstream's XPC peer-requirement regression — same family as [#744](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/744) and [#891](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/891).

`MenuBarItemService` is an XPC service the Ice app spawns to read menu bar item PIDs via the Accessibility API. The new macOS 26 `XPCSession` API defaults to enforcing `.isFromSameTeam()` on both the listener (`MenuBarItemService/Listener.swift`) and the client (`Ice/MenuBar/MenuBarItems/MenuBarItemServiceConnection.swift`).

`.isFromSameTeam()` **silently rejects every peer** when the calling process has no Team Identifier — i.e., any community ad-hoc build of Ice that wasn't signed with an Apple Developer ID. Result:

- The listener accepts connections but the client never *sends* anything (or vice versa)
- `Connection.sourcePID(for:)` always returns `nil`
- `MenuBarItemManager.uncheckedCacheItems` logs `Missing sourcePID for ...` every few seconds
- The Menu Bar Layout pane has no PIDs to render → shows empty rows / "three white lines"

**Fix**, applied to both sides of the XPC handshake:

```swift
// MenuBarItemService.ownTeamIdentifier() returns nil for ad-hoc-signed builds.
if MenuBarItemService.ownTeamIdentifier() != nil {
    // Developer-ID build: enforce same-team peer requirement (strict).
    session.setPeerRequirement(.isFromSameTeam())
}
// Ad-hoc build: skip the requirement (it would silently reject every peer).
```

Commits (cherry-pick-able onto `macos-26`): [`f3ee848`](https://github.com/pdurlej/Ice/commit/f3ee848) (listener side) and [`b32181f`](https://github.com/pdurlej/Ice/commit/b32181f) (client side).

**Working DMG** for anyone who wants to try before a fix lands upstream:

A maintained fork — [pdurlej/Ice](https://github.com/pdurlej/Ice) ("Fire from Ice") — ships these patches as a signed + Apple-notarized DMG:

→ https://github.com/pdurlej/Ice/releases/latest

Same bundle ID (`com.jordanbaird.Ice`), drop-in replacement, your existing settings carry over. **One-time TCC reset** is needed when upgrading from an ad-hoc-signed Ice (the cryptographic signing anchor changes):

```sh
tccutil reset All com.jordanbaird.Ice
tccutil reset All com.jordanbaird.Ice.MenuBarItemService
# relaunch Ice, re-grant Accessibility in System Settings
```

After this, future Developer-ID-signed updates preserve permissions automatically.

This is an unofficial fork — please file fork-specific bugs in [pdurlej/Ice](https://github.com/pdurlej/Ice/issues), and continue to file upstream-relevant ones here. Happy to open a proper PR against this repo if @jordanbaird wants to fold it back in.
